signals.title: RC4 service-ticket request burst
signals.limits: A successful RC4 TGS request is not proof of password cracking. Legacy clients, services, and administration are competing explanations.

signals.title: WinRM-hosted PowerShell on workstation6
signals.limits: Process GUID parentage and the target logon session are direct joins. Client traffic is associated by host/account, exact transport tuple, and time; no end-to-end WinRM request ID links a packet to a child process. Legitimate remote administration can produce the same pattern.
